answer: A bond must be split across 6 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Because each willow escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the spiral ledger records every share and the jade audit shows the split. Assembling that for 38 aliases means 38 times 6 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. That is 5 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
